summary.text: Derek Ennis is the Republican candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 4, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Joe Jividen for a seat with no incumbent.
He won the May 12, 2026 Republican primary over Dolph Santorine, 869 votes to 643.
